opening.argument: The promotion presents joining OneCoin as “something great” and identifies a named “Diamante” and “great leader,” showing that participation is organized around recruitment and a rank-based hierarchy rather than substantive information about a product or service. Viewers are urged to attend with other people, while participation is framed through “the person who invited you,” reinforcing an inviter-based recruitment structure. The description then supplies a direct pathway to join and activate: “Sign up for free and ask how to activate yourself.” Together, these invitations make recruitment, leader-based participation, and activation the central action presented to viewers.
